title: HullQ Organization-BoatDesign Relationship v0.1
description: An independently identifiable builder/manufacturer relationship between an Organization and a BoatDesign. A builder change alone must not create a new BoatDesign (ADR-0004/ADR-0011). Multiple time-bounded builders are supported.

organization_id.description: Reference to the Organization entity ID.

boat_design_id.description: Reference to the BoatDesign entity ID.

role.description: Builder/manufacturer role semantics for this relationship.

first_year.description: First year this Organization built/manufactured this design. Null when unknown.

last_year.description: Last year this Organization built/manufactured this design. Null when unknown or still active.

hull_number_from.description: Inclusive hull/build number boundary from. Null when unknown.

hull_number_to.description: Inclusive hull/build number boundary to. Null when unknown.

market.description: Optional market/region label when relationship was region-specific.
